title: "Correlation_Hyperpolarization_and_Resting_Potential"
author: "Mirja grote Lambers"
date: "2026-05-04"
output: html_document
---

This script tests the normal distribution of the hyperpolarisation amplitude induced by the addition of pinacidil or KCl, as well as the resting potential of the pericytes. It then calculates the Spearman rank correlation coefficient for the two variables, once for the combined sample (pinacidil + KCl) and once for the KCl subset only.  


# load data
df <- read.csv("Correlation_Hyperpolarization_and_Resting_Potential.csv")


# normality check
check_normality <- function(x, name) {
  sw <- shapiro.test(x)
  cat(sprintf("%s – Shapiro-Wilk: W = %.3f, p = %.3f\n", name, sw$statistic, sw$p.value))
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  hist(x, main = paste("Histogram –", name), xlab = name, col = "steelblue", border = "white")
  qqnorm(x, main = paste("QQ-Plot –", name))
  qqline(x, col = "red")
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}
check_normality(df$baseline_resting_potential_mV,  "Resting potential")
check_normality(df$hyperpolarisation_amplitude_mV, "Hyperpolarisation amplitude")# Spearman correlations
report_cor <- function(x, y, label) {
  ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman")
  p  <- ifelse(ct$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", ct$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("\n%s\n  rho = %.3f, p %s\n", label, ct$estimate, p))
  invisible(ct)
}
cor_pooled <- report_cor(df$baseline_resting_potential_mV,
                         df$hyperpolarisation_amplitude_mV, "Pooled (KCl + Pinacidil)")
df_kcl <- df[df$treatment == "KCl", ]
report_cor(df_kcl$baseline_resting_potential_mV,
           df_kcl$hyperpolarisation_amplitude_mV, "KCl only")


# scatter plot
x <- df$baseline_resting_potential_mV
y <- df$hyperpolarisation_amplitude_mV
col_map <- c("Pinacidil" = "#7b739cd6", "KCl" = "#3c8097")

fit   <- lm(y ~ x)
x_seq <- seq(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 200)
pred  <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_seq), interval = "confidence")
p     <- ifelse(cor_pooled$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", cor_pooled$p.value))
ann   <- sprintf("rho = %.3f, p %s", unname(cor_pooled$estimate), p)

plot(x, y, type = "n", xlab = "Resting potential (mV)", ylab = "\u0394Vm (mV)", las = 1)
polygon(c(x_seq, rev(x_seq)), c(pred[, "lwr"], rev(pred[, "upr"])),
        col = adjustcolor("gray", alpha.f = 0.2), border = NA)
lines(x_seq, pred[, "fit"], col = "gray40", lwd = 1.5)
points(x, y, col = col_map[df$treatment], pch = 19, cex = 0.9)
legend("topright",  legend = ann, bty = "n", cex = 0.9)
legend("bottomleft", legend = names(col_map), col = col_map, pch = 19,
       title = "Treatment", title.adj = 0, bty = "n")
